subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust and land these updated immutable action revisions across credential-bearing, security-scanning, release, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but choosing third-party executable revisions that receive secrets or elevated permissions is a repository trust decision that automated checks cannot fully resolve.

options.title: Approve final exact head
options.body: Review the upstream revisions and approve the batch once required checks complete on the final rebased head.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, registry, CodeQL, and Codex-action updates into narrower PRs for independent owner review.

options.title: Pause unresolved revisions
options.body: Keep the batch open if any upstream change or exact-head failure cannot be confidently explained.
